_note: Core + detachment stratagems, keyed by id. See NEW_ARMY_BUILD_GUIDE.md §4.4. detachment:null means a Core stratagem, available in every list. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.

command-re-roll.name: Command Re-roll
command-re-roll.summary: Re-roll one dice you just rolled.
command-re-roll.when: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Damage roll, a Hazard roll, a Hit roll, a Save roll, a Wound roll, or a roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.
command-re-roll.effect: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

epic-challenge.name: Epic Challenge
epic-challenge.when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
epic-challenge.effect: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

insane-bravery.name: Insane Bravery
insane-bravery.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a Battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.
insane-bravery.effect: That Battle-shock roll is automatically successful.
insane-bravery.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

fire-overwatch.name: Fire Overwatch
fire-overwatch.summary: Snap shoot at the end of your opponent's Movement phase.
fire-overwatch.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
fire-overwatch.effect: Your unit shoots using a Snap Shooting action. While snap shooting: you can only target one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit (and only if it is an eligible target); each attack only hits on an unmodified Hit roll of 6 (irrespective of the attacking weapon's BS characteristic or any modifiers); and you cannot re-roll Hit rolls.
fire-overwatch.restrictions: After shooting, until the end of the phase your unit is not eligible to start an Action.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.summary: A SMOKE unit and what it screens gain the Benefit of Cover.
smokescreen.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
smokescreen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

heroic-intervention.name: Heroic Intervention
heroic-intervention.summary: Charge at the end of your opponent's Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE/WALKER unit if it is a CHARACTER unit.
heroic-intervention.effect:
Resolve a charge with your unit. Before making the charge roll, select one of the following modes:
• Leap to Defend — when selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the Maximum charge distance.
• Into the Fray (+1CP) — when making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6; and when selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units within 6" of your unit and within the Maximum charge distance.

krump-em.name: Krump ’Em
krump-em.summary: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
krump-em.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ’ARDMOB unit is selected to fight.

medi-squigs.name: Medi-Squigs
medi-squigs.summary: Your unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
medi-squigs.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ’ARDMOB unit.

get-stuck-in.name: Get Stuck In
get-stuck-in.summary: Surge move up to D6+1" after being shot at.
get-stuck-in.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ’ARDMOB unit has shot.
get-stuck-in.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

counter-offensive.name: Counter-offensive
counter-offensive.summary: Fight out of sequence, with Fights First.
counter-offensive.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
counter-offensive.target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
counter-offensive.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight.

_war_horde_note: War Horde detachment stratagems. The id 'war-horde-ard-as-nails' is deliberately prefixed: the stratagem is called ’Ard As Nails, but 'ard-as-nails' is already the id of the Combat Patrol DETACHMENT in data/combat-patrol/index.json. They are unrelated content and must not be merged.

careen.name: Careen!
careen.summary: A destroyed vehicle rolls one last move before it blows.
careen.when: Any phase, just after an ORKS VEHICLE unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
careen.target: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
careen.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.

orks-is-never-beaten.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
orks-is-never-beaten.summary: Slain models still get to swing before they go.
orks-is-never-beaten.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
orks-is-never-beaten.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
orks-is-never-beaten.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

unbridled-carnage.name: Unbridled Carnage
unbridled-carnage.summary: Melee attacks score Critical Hits on an unmodified 5+.
unbridled-carnage.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
unbridled-carnage.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

war-horde-ard-as-nails.name: ’Ard As Nails
war-horde-ard-as-nails.summary: −1 to Wound rolls against your unit.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS, MONSTER and VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

mob-rule.name: Mob Rule
mob-rule.summary: A big mob shouts a nearby unit out of Battle-shock.
mob-rule.target: One MOB unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
mob-rule.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ORKS INFANTRY unit within 6" of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

ere-we-go.name: ’Ere We Go
ere-we-go.target: One ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army.
ere-we-go.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.

_da_big_hunt_note: Da Big Hunt detachment stratagems. Several refer to your Prey, which is nominated by the Da Hunt Is On detachment rule — the app does not track it, so the wording carries the condition.

drag-it-down.name: Drag It Down
drag-it-down.type: Da Big Hunt – Battle Tactic Stratagem
drag-it-down.summary: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] in melee, and Criticals on 5+ against your Prey.
drag-it-down.target: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
drag-it-down.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Prey, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

unstoppable-momentum.name: Unstoppable Momentum
unstoppable-momentum.type: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
unstoppable-momentum.summary: Mortal wounds on the charge, with three extra dice against your Prey.
unstoppable-momentum.when: Your Charge phase, just after a BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army ends a Charge move.
unstoppable-momentum.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If that enemy unit is your Prey, roll three additional D6.

dat-ones-even-bigga.name: Dat One’s Even Bigga!
dat-ones-even-bigga.type: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
dat-ones-even-bigga.summary: Charge after Advancing or Falling Back, and re-roll the charge.
dat-ones-even-bigga.target: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army.
dat-ones-even-bigga.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls made for your unit. If you do, your unit must end that charge move engaged with your Prey.

where-dya-fink-youre-going.name: Where D’ya Fink You’re Going?
where-dya-fink-youre-going.type: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
where-dya-fink-youre-going.summary: Chase down a unit that just Fell Back with a 6" move.
where-dya-fink-youre-going.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
where-dya-fink-youre-going.target: One BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY or BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
where-dya-fink-youre-going.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stalkin-taktiks.name: Stalkin’ Taktiks
stalkin-taktiks.type: Da Big Hunt – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stalkin-taktiks.summary: Benefit of Cover, plus Stealth for INFANTRY.
stalkin-taktiks.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stalkin-taktiks.target: One BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY or BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stalkin-taktiks.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack. In addition, if your unit has the INFANTRY keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.

instinctive-hunters.name: Instinctive Hunters
instinctive-hunters.type: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
instinctive-hunters.summary: Pull a disengaged unit back into Strategic Reserves.
instinctive-hunters.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
instinctive-hunters.target: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy unit.
instinctive-hunters.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

_kult_of_speed_note: Kult of Speed detachment stratagems. Dakkastorm and Blitza Fire exclude each other on the same unit in the same phase; that is carried in each one's `restrictions` field.

speediest-freeks.name: Speediest Freeks
speediest-freeks.type: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
speediest-freeks.summary: 5+ invulnerable save, or 4+ for a T8-or-less vehicle.
speediest-freeks.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
speediest-freeks.target: One SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
speediest-freeks.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.

squig-flingin.name: Squig Flingin’
squig-flingin.type: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
squig-flingin.summary: Force a Battle-shock test at −1 after moving.
squig-flingin.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
squig-flingin.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.

dakkastorm.name: Dakkastorm
dakkastorm.type: Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem
dakkastorm.target: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
dakkastorm.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9", they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
dakkastorm.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Blitza Fire Stratagem in the same phase.

blitza-fire.name: Blitza Fire
blitza-fire.type: Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem
blitza-fire.target: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
blitza-fire.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 9", a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
blitza-fire.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Dakkastorm Stratagem in the same phase.

full-throttle.name: Full Throttle!
full-throttle.type: Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem
full-throttle.summary: +1 to Wound in melee after charging.
full-throttle.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
full-throttle.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

more-gitz-over-ere.name: More Gitz Over ’Ere!
more-gitz-over-ere.type: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
more-gitz-over-ere.summary: 6" Normal move when an enemy moves nearby.
more-gitz-over-ere.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
more-gitz-over-ere.target: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
more-gitz-over-ere.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

_dread_mob_note: Dread Mob detachment stratagems. Three of them carry a 'push it' option that adds [HAZARDOUS] on top of a bigger effect; that choice is part of the effect wording, not a separate stratagem.

klankin-klaws.name: Klankin’ Klaws
klankin-klaws.summary: +2 S in melee, or push it for +1 D and [HAZARDOUS].
klankin-klaws.target: One ORKS WALKER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
klankin-klaws.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit and, if you chose to push it, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons and they have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

superfuelled-boiler.name: Superfuelled Boiler
superfuelled-boiler.summary: Re-roll Advance, and ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT].
superfuelled-boiler.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS WALKER unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
superfuelled-boiler.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

bigger-shells-for-bigger-gitz.name: Bigger Shells For Bigger Gitz
bigger-shells-for-bigger-gitz.summary: +1 to Wound vs MONSTER and VEHICLE, or push it for +1 D.
bigger-shells-for-bigger-gitz.target: One MEK, ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
bigger-shells-for-bigger-gitz.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll. If you chose to push it, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

dakka-dakka-dakka.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
dakka-dakka-dakka.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or push it to re-roll any Hit roll.
dakka-dakka-dakka.target: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
dakka-dakka-dakka.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If you chose to push it, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

conniving-runts.name: Conniving Runts
conniving-runts.summary: 4+ for D3+1 mortal wounds, then a Normal move.
conniving-runts.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
conniving-runts.target: One GRETCHIN unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
conniving-runts.effect: Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move.

extra-gubbinz.name: Extra Gubbinz
extra-gubbinz.summary: −1 to the Damage of every attack allocated to your unit.
extra-gubbinz.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
extra-gubbinz.target: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
extra-gubbinz.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

_green_tide_note: Green Tide detachment stratagems. Most scale on whether the target unit contains 10 or more models; Braggin' Rights instead makes two units COUNT as 10+ regardless of their real size.

competitive-streak.name: Competitive Streak
competitive-streak.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or all of them at 10+ models.
competitive-streak.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
competitive-streak.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

bulldozer-brutality.name: Bulldozer Brutality
bulldozer-brutality.summary: Models within 3" of the enemy are eligible to fight.
bulldozer-brutality.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
bulldozer-brutality.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

braggin-rights.name: Braggin’ Rights
braggin-rights.summary: Two nearby units both count as containing 10 or more models.
braggin-rights.target: Two BOYZ units from your army that are within 6" of each other.
braggin-rights.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6" of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.

come-on-ladz.name: Come On Ladz!
come-on-ladz.summary: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models.
come-on-ladz.effect: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding CHARACTER models).

tide-of-muscle.name: Tide of Muscle
tide-of-muscle.summary: +1 to Charge rolls, and re-roll them at 10+ models.
tide-of-muscle.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
tide-of-muscle.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

go-get-em.name: Go Get ’Em!
go-get-em.summary: Surge move up to D6" after being shot at.
go-get-em.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BOYZ unit this phase has shot.
go-get-em.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

_bully_boyz_note: Bully Boyz detachment stratagems. Every one of the six has a stronger mode while a Waaagh! is active for the target unit; that condition is carried in the effect wording, not tracked by the app.

armed-to-da-teef.name: Armed to da Teef
armed-to-da-teef._name_note: Ran together as 'ARMED TO DATEEF' in the supplied text; split back into words, wording otherwise untouched.
armed-to-da-teef.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or all of them under a Waaagh!.
armed-to-da-teef.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
armed-to-da-teef.target: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
armed-to-da-teef.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

too-arrogant-to-die.name: Too Arrogant To Die
too-arrogant-to-die.summary: 5+ to let a slain model shoot or fight before it goes.
too-arrogant-to-die.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
too-arrogant-to-die.target: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
too-arrogant-to-die.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if a Waaagh! is active for your unit. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

always-lookin-fer-a-fight.name: Always Lookin’ Fer a Fight
always-lookin-fer-a-fight.summary: D3+3" Consolidation moves, or 6" under a Waaagh!.
always-lookin-fer-a-fight.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed.
always-lookin-fer-a-fight.target: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that destroyed that enemy unit.
always-lookin-fer-a-fight.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, it can move up to 6" instead.

krushin-impact.name: Krushin’ Impact
krushin-impact.summary: Mortal wounds on a 5+ per model, or a 4+ under a Waaagh!.
krushin-impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army ends a Charge move.
krushin-impact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+ instead.

cut-em-down.name: Cut ’Em Down
cut-em-down._name_note: Ran together as "CUT'EM DOWN" in the supplied text; spacing restored, wording untouched.
cut-em-down.summary: Force Desperate Escape tests, at −1 under a Waaagh!.
cut-em-down.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
cut-em-down.target: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
cut-em-down.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if a Waaagh! is active for your unit, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

hulking-brutes.name: Hulking Brutes
hulking-brutes.summary: Worsen the AP of every attack against your unit by 1.
hulking-brutes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
hulking-brutes.target: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
hulking-brutes.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

_freebooter_krew_note: Freebooter Krew detachment stratagems. Several reference the loot objective nominated by the Here Be Loot detachment rule; the app does not track it, so the wording carries the condition.

bash-and-grab.name: Bash and Grab
bash-and-grab.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls against a unit on the loot objective.
bash-and-grab.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
bash-and-grab.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

grab-and-bash.name: Grab and Bash
grab-and-bash.summary: Turn the Waaagh! on for one unit, even if already called.
grab-and-bash.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GRETCHIN units) that is within range of the loot objective.
grab-and-bash.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle.

Designer’s Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.

boardin-rush.name: Boardin’ Rush
boardin-rush.summary: Advance without rolling — a flat +6" Move instead.
boardin-rush.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
boardin-rush.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

deck-fraggers.name: Deck Fraggers
deck-fraggers.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
deck-fraggers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit targets an INFANTRY unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon has the [BLAST] ability.

rolling-loot-heap.name: Rolling Loot-heap
rolling-loot-heap.target: One FLASH GITZ unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
rolling-loot-heap.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] ability.

krump-and-run.name: Krump and Run
krump-and-run.summary: 6" Normal move when an engaged enemy Falls Back.
krump-and-run.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
krump-and-run._target_note: The final clause reads 'is not within range of one or more enemy units' in the supplied text, where the parallel stratagems in other detachments say Engagement Range. Left verbatim rather than assumed — confirm against the datasheet.
krump-and-run.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is not within range of one or more enemy units.
krump-and-run.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
